content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN).**

Section 12 contains indemnities in both directions, but they are badly unbalanced and, critically, TrueLink's indemnity (¶p0073/p0075) is confined to claims arising from its own breach or non-performance. There is no vendor IP infringement indemnity — and no non-infringement warranty to back into — anywhere in the agreement; the only infringement language runs against Client (¶p0024, p0041, p0055). That fails even the fallback position, which requires a vendor IP indemnity.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): expand Section 12(b) to add (ii) IP infringement/misappropriation allegations concerning the Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services and other TrueLink deliverables; (iii) TrueLink's breach of law; (iv) unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content/data caused by TrueLink; and (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. This is the minimum edit to reach the preferred position while leaving the Section 12 cap (Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 only) untouched. Customary IP exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies remain available as a negotiating trade.
